zh: 显式 IV：每记录自带 IV，取代 CBC 残值。
bad_record_mac：填充错误改用的单一告警。
[CBCATT]：本版本针对的 CBC 攻击类别。
等时处理：填充对错须花相同时间。
回退版本检查：客户端 MUST、服务器 MAY。
en: Explicit IV: each record carries its own IV instead of the CBC residue.
bad_record_mac: the single alert now used for padding errors.
[CBCATT]: the class of CBC attacks this version targets.
Constant-time handling: padding validity must not change timing.
Rollback check asymmetric: MUST for clients, MAY for servers.
Obsoletes: 2246: the record that supersedes TLS 1.0.
